FX-WIDTH-001.says: Shape, width 1: the drawing grows one pixel up, down, left and right. The half-covering edge in column 1 becomes solid line, and a new half-covering edge appears in column 0; the corners stay square-cut.

FX-WIDTH-002.says: Shape, width 1.5: the diagonal neighbours count too, so the corners fill out as well.

FX-WIDTH-003.says: Shape, width -1: the drawing shrinks one pixel. The box's outer line touches the transparent outside and goes; the line in column 2 touches the half-covering edge and becomes half covering, still the line's colour.

FX-WIDTH-005.says: Colours, the line chosen, width 1: the line spreads one pixel into the skin inside and the transparent outside, filling the skin between the red trace line's ends and the box; the trace line itself is untouched.

FX-WIDTH-006.says: Colours, the trace line chosen, width -1: a one-pixel line thinned by one is gone; each of its pixels takes the skin above it, which wins the tie with the skin below.

FX-WIDTH-007.says: Colours, the trace line chosen, width 2: the red line grows two pixels up and down and sideways, painting over the skin and the box's line alike.

FX-WIDTH-008.says: Shape, width keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 1 is FX-WIDTH-001, and frames 2 and 4 grow two and four pixels.

FX-WIDTH-009.says: FX-WIDTH-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-WIDTH-010.says: Colours with no colour chosen, width 3: the drawing, untouched.

FX-WIDTH-011.says: Shape with the line listed as a colour: the colours are kept but not used, and the frame is FX-WIDTH-001.

FX-WIDTH-012.says: Shape, width -20: the drawing, six pixels tall, is gone.

FX-WIDTH-013.says: Width 21, above 20. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIDTH-014.says: Width -21, below -20. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIDTH-015.says: Width keyed to 25 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIDTH-016.says: Tolerance 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIDTH-017.says: Based on "line", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIDTH-018.says: Nine colours, one more than eight. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-WIDTH-019.says: A colour written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
